verify: T=$(mktemp -d); perl -e 'alarm 300; exec @ARGV' sh tools/test_rig_check.sh tools/rig_check.sh > $T/ms1-red.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -c 'FAIL' $T/ms1-red.log   # want: rc=1, 7 FAILs, base 8 ok
milestones.notes: MS1 red (unmodified tools/rig_check.sh, rc 1, perl alarm 300): 16 cases, 7 failures. Ok: the 8 base cases plus full-no-setup (9 ok lines). FAIL: golden-only-setup (calls sky-assets golden), golden-setup (sky-assets test golden), golden-setup-red (no failure post), setup-hang (no deps call, no child), sky-hang (rc 0), runtime-hang (desc mismatch), caller-poison (nested 9 of 15 ok). DEVIATION: the plan said exactly 7 new cases FAIL; full-no-setup passes on the unmodified script because the current rig already has no setup on the rig/full path, so it is a regression guard that only a mutant can turn red. Reaper positive control (live sleep seen by kill -0) passes. Wall time about 260 s total (sky-hang and runtime-hang 20 s each, doubled by caller-poison). Orphan sleep 20 count before 4 (pre-existing, other sessions), after 4. Log: /tmp/iter81-evidence/ms1-red.log
